verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
OMUTWE gwa Mukama,
Ogwafumitibwa
Amaggwa ge baaluka
Okukuduulira.
Ye ffe abandirabye
Ennaku zo zonna,
Mu kifo kyo bandisse
Ffe-abalina-ebibi.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Tuli boonoonyi ddala,
Ggwe-oli Mutukuvu;
Mu maaso ga Kitaawo
Toyonoonangako.
Twewombeese kaakano,
Tukuvuunamidde,
Tusaanidde okufa
Naye otulokole.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Naafuna ntya-ebigambo
Eby'okukwebaza?
Wayiwa-omusaayi gwo
Ku lwaffe ku muti.
Essanyu lye watuwa
Tunaalyenkanya wa?
Lisinga lyonna lyonna
Ery'omu nsi zonna.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Lulimi ki-oluyinza
Okwolesa-ekisa,
N'okwagala kwo-okungi
Yesu bye walaga?
Otenderezebwenga,
Mulokozi waffe
Kaakano n'okutuusa
Emirembe gyonna
